fields.name: SubjectUserSid

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that cleared the system security audit log.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with other events containing the same Logon ID, such as event 4624.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that reported information about the successful logon.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that reported information about the successful logon.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with other events containing the same value.

fields.name: TargetUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account for which the logon was performed.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account for which the logon was performed.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the account for which the logon was performed.

fields.name: TargetLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID of the new logon session, usable to correlate with related events such as 4672.

fields.name: LogonType
fields.description: Numeric code indicating the type of logon performed (e.g. Interactive, Network, Service, RemoteInteractive).

fields.name: LogonProcessName
fields.description: Name of the trusted logon process that was used for the logon.

fields.name: AuthenticationPackageName
fields.description: Name of the authentication package used for the logon (e.g. NTLM, Kerberos, Negotiate).

fields.name: WorkstationName
fields.description: Machine name from which the logon attempt was performed.

fields.name: LogonGuid
fields.description: GUID usable to correlate this event with related events such as 4769 or 4648 that share the same Logon GUID.

fields.name: TransmittedServices
fields.description: List of transmitted services, populated only for Kerberos S4U logons.

fields.name: LmPackageName
fields.description: Name of the LAN Manager subpackage (NTLM-family protocol) used during the logon, e.g. NTLM V1/V2/LM.

fields.name: KeyLength
fields.description: Length of the NTLM Session Security key; always 0 for Kerberos.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the process that attempted the logon.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.description: Full path and name of the executable for the process that attempted the logon.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: IP address of the machine from which the logon attempt was performed.

fields.name: IpPort
fields.description: Source port used for the logon attempt from a remote machine; 0 for interactive logons.

fields.name: ImpersonationLevel
fields.description: Impersonation level assigned to the new logon token (Anonymous, Identification, Impersonation, or Delegation).

fields.name: RestrictedAdminMode
fields.description: Yes/No flag indicating whether the credentials were passed using Restricted Admin mode, populated only for RemoteInteractive logons.

fields.name: TargetOutboundUserName
fields.description: User name used for outbound network connections; valid only for NewCredentials logon type.

fields.name: TargetOutboundDomainName
fields.description: Domain for the user used for outbound network connections; valid only for NewCredentials logon type.

fields.name: VirtualAccount
fields.description: Yes/No flag indicating whether the account is a virtual account such as a Managed Service Account.

fields.name: TargetLinkedLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID of the paired logon session, or 0x0 if none exists.

fields.name: ElevatedToken
fields.description: Yes/No flag indicating whether the new logon session is elevated with administrator privileges.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that reported information about the logon failure.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that reported information about the logon failure.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID usable to correlate this event with recent events containing the same value.

fields.name: TargetUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that was specified in the logon attempt.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that was specified in the logon attempt.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the account specified in the logon attempt.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Hexadecimal NTSTATUS code indicating the reason the logon failed, e.g. 0xC0000234 for account locked out.

fields.name: FailureReason
fields.description: Textual explanation of the Status field value, e.g. "Account locked out".

fields.name: SubStatus
fields.description: Additional hexadecimal status code providing more detail about the logon failure.

fields.name: LogonType
fields.description: Numeric code indicating the type of logon that was attempted.

fields.name: LogonProcessName
fields.description: Name of the trusted logon process that was used for the logon attempt.

fields.name: AuthenticationPackageName
fields.description: Name of the authentication package used for the logon authentication process.

fields.name: WorkstationName
fields.description: Machine name from which the logon attempt was performed.

fields.name: TransmittedServices
fields.description: List of transmitted services, populated only if the logon was a result of a Kerberos S4U process.

fields.name: LmPackageName
fields.description: Name of the LAN Manager subpackage used during the logon attempt, e.g. NTLM V1/V2/LM.

fields.name: KeyLength
fields.description: Length of the NTLM Session Security key; always 0 for Kerberos.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the process that attempted the logon.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.description: Full path and name of the executable for the process that attempted the logon.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: IP address of the machine from which the logon attempt was performed.

fields.name: IpPort
fields.description: Source port used for the logon attempt from a remote machine; 0 for interactive logons.

fields.name: TargetUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that was logged off.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that was logged off.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the account that was logged off.

fields.name: TargetLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID usable to correlate this event with related events such as the originating 4624 logon.

fields.name: LogonType
fields.description: Numeric code indicating the type of logon session that was terminated.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the new logon session with explicit credentials.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the new logon session with explicit credentials.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID of the subject's existing session, usable for correlation with related events.

fields.name: LogonGuid
fields.description: GUID of the subject's session, usable to correlate with related events such as 4769 or 4624.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account whose credentials were used.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the account whose credentials were used.

fields.name: TargetLogonGuid
fields.description: GUID of the new logon session created with the explicit credentials, usable for correlation with related events.

fields.name: TargetServerName
fields.description: Name of the server on which the new process was run; has the value "localhost" if run locally.

fields.name: TargetInfo
fields.description: Additional information about the target server.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the process that was run using the explicit credentials.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.description: Full path and name of the executable for the process.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: IP address of the machine from which the logon attempt was performed.

fields.name: IpPort
fields.description: Source port used for the logon attempt from a remote machine; 0 for interactive logons.

description: Operation performed on Active Directory object

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that made an attempt to access an object.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that made an attempt to access an object.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID usable to correlate this event with recent events containing the same value.

fields.name: ObjectServer
fields.description: Subsystem that generated the event; has the value "Security" for this event.

fields.name: ObjectType
fields.description: Type of the object that was accessed during the operation, e.g. File or Key.

fields.name: ObjectName
fields.description: Name and other identifying information for the object for which access was requested.

fields.name: HandleId
fields.description: Hexadecimal handle to the object, usable for correlation with other events such as 4656.

fields.name: AccessList
fields.description: List of access rights that were used by the subject when accessing the object.

fields.name: AccessMask
fields.description: Hexadecimal mask corresponding to the access rights listed in AccessList.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the process that accessed the object.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.description: Full path and name of the executable for the process.

fields.name: ResourceAttributes
fields.description: Attributes associated with the object, such as resource property claims; displays "-" if not applicable.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the change to the object's permissions.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the change to the object's permissions.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID usable to correlate this event with recent events containing the same value.

fields.name: ObjectServer
fields.description: Subsystem that generated the event; has the value "Security" for this event.

fields.name: ObjectType
fields.description: Type of the object whose permissions were changed, e.g. File or Key.

fields.name: ObjectName
fields.description: Name and other identifying information for the object whose permissions were changed; "-" for Token objects.

fields.name: HandleId
fields.description: Hexadecimal handle to the object, usable for correlation with other events such as 4663.

fields.name: OldSd
fields.description: Old Security Descriptor Definition Language (SDDL) value for the object before the permission change.

fields.name: NewSd
fields.description: New Security Descriptor Definition Language (SDDL) value for the object after the permission change.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the process through which the permissions were changed.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.description: Full path and name of the executable for the process.

description: Special privileges assigned to new logon

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account to which special privileges were assigned.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account to which special privileges were assigned.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal Logon ID usable to correlate this event with recent events containing the same value.

fields.name: PrivilegeList
fields.description: Space-separated list of sensitive privileges assigned to the new logon, e.g. SeDebugPrivilege or SeBackupPrivilege.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the create-process operation (the process creator).

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the create-process operation.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject (process creator) account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the creator's logon session.

fields.name: TargetUserSid
fields.description: SID of the target account, included when the process creator and target run under different logon sessions.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the target account associated with the new process.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the target account.

fields.name: TargetLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID of the target account's logon session.

fields.name: NewProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID assigned to the newly created process.

fields.name: NewProcessName
fields.description: Full path and file name of the executable for the newly created process.

fields.name: TokenElevationType
fields.description: Indicates whether the new process token is a full, elevated, or limited/UAC-filtered token.

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.description: Hexadecimal process ID of the creator process that launched the new process.

fields.name: CommandLine
fields.description: Executable name and arguments passed to the new process; empty unless command-line auditing is enabled via Group Policy.

fields.name: ParentProcessName
fields.description: Full path and file name of the executable for the process that created (spawned) the new process.

fields.name: MandatoryLabel
fields.description: SID of the mandatory integrity label (e.g., low, medium, high, system) assigned to the new process.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the create-scheduled-task operation.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the create-scheduled-task operation.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the subject's logon session.

fields.name: TaskName
fields.description: Name and path of the newly created scheduled task within the Task Scheduler Library.

fields.name: TaskContent
fields.description: XML content defining the configuration of the newly created scheduled task.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that made the change to the local audit policy.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that made the change to the local audit policy.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the subject's logon session.

fields.name: CategoryId
fields.description: Name of the top-level audit policy category containing the subcategory that was changed.

fields.name: SubcategoryId
fields.description: Name of the specific audit policy subcategory that was changed.

fields.name: SubcategoryGuid
fields.description: Unique GUID identifying the audit policy subcategory that was changed.

fields.name: AuditPolicyChanges
fields.description: The specific change(s) applied to the subcategory's auditing setting, such as Success added/removed or Failure added/removed.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the create-user-account operation.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the create-user-account operation.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the subject's logon session.

fields.name: TargetSid
fields.description: SID of the newly created user account.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name (sAMAccountName-style) of the user account that was created.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name to which the newly created account belongs.

fields.name: SamAccountName
fields.description: Pre-Windows 2000 (SAM) logon name assigned to the new user account.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: Display name attribute of the new user account, as shown in the address book.

fields.name: UserPrincipalName
fields.description: Internet-style logon name (UPN) of the new account, typically matching its email name.

fields.name: HomeDirectory
fields.description: Path configured as the user's home directory.

fields.name: HomePath
fields.description: Drive letter mapped to the UNC path specified by the account's home directory attribute.

fields.name: ScriptPath
fields.description: Path to the account's logon script.

fields.name: ProfilePath
fields.description: Path configured for the account's user profile.

fields.name: UserWorkstations
fields.description: List of NetBIOS or DNS computer names from which the user is permitted to log on.

fields.name: PasswordLastSet
fields.description: Timestamp of the last time the account's password was modified; shows <never> for manually created accounts.

fields.name: AccountExpires
fields.description: Date on which the account expires.

fields.name: PrimaryGroupId
fields.description: Relative Identifier (RID) of the new user object's primary group, typically 513 (Domain Users/Users).

fields.name: AllowedToDelegateTo
fields.description: List of Service Principal Names to which this account is permitted to present delegated credentials.

fields.name: OldUacValue
fields.description: Previous UserAccountControl value; always 0x0 for a newly created account.

fields.name: NewUacValue
fields.description: New hexadecimal UserAccountControl (SAM) bitmask controlling password, lockout, enable/disable, script, and other account behavior.

fields.name: UserAccountControl
fields.description: Decoded, human-readable list of the UAC flags corresponding to the New UAC Value bitmask (e.g., account disabled, password not required).

fields.name: UserParameters
fields.description: Dial-in and related settings for the account; shows <value changed, but not displayed> when modified via Active Directory Users and Computers.

fields.name: SidHistory
fields.description: Previous SIDs retained for the account if it was migrated from another domain.

fields.name: LogonHours
fields.description: Hours during which the account is permitted to log on to the domain.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that attempted to reset the target account's password.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that attempted to reset the target account's password.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the subject's logon session.

fields.name: TargetSid
fields.description: SID of the account for which the password reset was requested.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account for which the password reset was requested.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the target account.

fields.name: SubjectUserSid

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with the subject's logon session.

fields.name: TargetUserName

fields.name: PrivilegeList

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested the user account change.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested the user account change.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the subject account.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with a corresponding logon event.

fields.name: TargetSid
fields.description: SID of the account that was changed.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that was changed.

fields.name: TargetDomainName
fields.description: Domain or computer name of the target account that was changed.

fields.name: SamAccountName
fields.description: New value of the sAMAccountName (pre-Windows 2000 logon name) attribute if it was changed.

fields.name: DisplayName

fields.name: UserPrincipalName
fields.description: New value of the userPrincipalName attribute (internet-style login name) if it was changed.

fields.name: HomeDirectory

fields.name: HomePath

fields.name: ScriptPath

fields.name: ProfilePath

fields.name: UserWorkstations
fields.description: New value of the userWorkstations attribute (comma-separated list of computers the user can log on from) if it was changed.

fields.name: PasswordLastSet

fields.name: AccountExpires

fields.name: PrimaryGroupId
fields.description: New Relative Identifier (RID) of the user's primary group if the primaryGroupID attribute was changed.

fields.name: AllowedToDelegateTo

fields.name: OldUacValue

fields.name: UserAccountControl

fields.name: UserParameters

fields.name: LogonHours
fields.description: New value of the logonHours attribute, specifying the hours the account is allowed to log on to the domain.

fields.name: PrivilegeList

fields.name: SubjectDomainName

fields.name: TargetUserName

fields.description: SID of the account for which the TGT was requested; shown as NULL SID on failure events.

fields.name: TicketOptions

fields.name: CertSerialNumber

fields.name: CertThumbprint

fields.name: ResponseTicket

fields.name: TargetDomainName

fields.name: LogonGuid

fields.name: AccountAvailableKeys

fields.name: ServiceSid

fields.name: ServiceSupportedEncryptionTypes

fields.name: ServiceAvailableKeys
fields.description: List of encryption keys available for the service account, generated during password sets/changes.

fields.name: DCSupportedEncryptionTypes

fields.name: DCAvailableKeys
fields.description: List of encryption keys available for the domain controller, generated during password sets/changes and DCPROMO.

fields.name: IpAddress

fields.name: IpPort

fields.name: TicketEncryptionType

fields.description: Hexadecimal failure code of the TGS issue operation, where 0x0 indicates success (documented as "Failure Code").

fields.description: List of Service Principal Names requested when constrained Kerberos delegation was used.

fields.name: RequestTicketHash
fields.description: Hash of the ticket the client sent to the domain controller as part of the Kerberos request.

fields.name: ResponseTicketHash
fields.description: Hash of the ticket the domain controller returned to the client as part of the response.

fields.name: TargetSid
fields.description: SID of the account for which the TGT was requested.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account for which the TGT was requested; computer account names end with $.

fields.name: ServiceName
fields.description: Name of the service in the Kerberos realm to which the TGT request was sent, typically krbtgt/DOMAIN_NAME.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: IP address of the computer from which the TGT request was received.

fields.name: IpPort
fields.description: Source port number of the client's TGT request connection; 0 for local requests.

fields.name: TicketOptions
fields.description: Hexadecimal set of Kerberos ticket flags requested (e.g., Forwardable, Renewable, Canonicalize).

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Hexadecimal failure code of the failed TGT issue operation as defined in RFC 4120 (documented as "Failure Code").

fields.name: PreAuthType
fields.description: Code identifying the pre-authentication type used in the TGT request.

fields.name: CertIssuerName
fields.description: Name of the Certification Authority that issued the smart card certificate; always empty for this event.

fields.name: CertSerialNumber
fields.description: Serial number of the smart card certificate; always empty for this event.

fields.name: CertThumbprint
fields.description: Thumbprint of the smart card certificate; always empty for this event.

fields.name: PackageName
fields.description: Name of the authentication package used for credential validation, always MICROSOFT_AUTHENTICATION_PACKAGE_V1_0 for this event.

fields.name: TargetUserName
fields.description: Name of the account whose credentials were validated by the authentication package (documented as "Logon Account").

fields.name: Workstation
fields.description: Name of the computer from which the logon attempt originated (documented as "Source Workstation").

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Hexadecimal error code for failure events, or 0x0 for success events (documented as "Error Code").

fields.name: SubjectUserSid
fields.description: SID of the account that requested access to the network share object.

fields.name: SubjectUserName
fields.description: Name of the account that requested access to the network share object.

fields.name: SubjectDomainName
fields.description: Subject's domain or computer name.

fields.name: SubjectLogonId
fields.description: Hexadecimal logon ID that can be used to correlate this event with other events containing the same Logon ID, such as event 4624.

fields.name: ObjectType
fields.description: The type of object that was accessed during the operation; always "File" for this event.

fields.name: IpAddress
fields.description: Source IP address from which access was performed (IPv6, ::ffff:IPv4, or ::1/127.0.0.1 for localhost).

fields.name: IpPort
fields.description: Source TCP or UDP port used from the remote or local machine to request access; 0 for local access attempts.

fields.name: ShareName
fields.description: Name of the accessed network share, in the format \\*\SHARE_NAME.

fields.name: ShareLocalPath
fields.description: Full system (NTFS) path for the accessed share, in the format \??\PATH; can be empty.

fields.name: AccessMask
fields.description: Sum of the hexadecimal values of the requested access rights; always "0x1" for this event.

fields.name: AccessList
fields.description: List of access rights requested by the Subject's Security ID; always "ReadData (or ListDirectory)" for this event.
